review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and the two task keys are preserved. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision, so its ready expectation and empty human-decision input are consistent; a material unresolved DEC-001 in B must instead block at decisions. The supplied source places normalization, vocabulary sets and truthy-first behavior in core/api.ts, with classic and mini forwarding to that shared implementation. The four exact writable paths cover implementation, both regression suites and the explicitly absent planned measurement entry; forwarding consumers remain inspection owners, and build configuration supports generated declarations rather than separately maintained declaration owners. Runtime and type checking are distinguished, and the PRD retains baseline-first sampling, interleaved revision comparisons, retained-heap measurements and separate classic/mini bundle obligations. TASK-VERIFY depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT and requires independent coverage of all required acceptance criteria. The designated implementer and verifier have matching roles, availability and supplied project-scoped active capability claims; broader member capability labels and personas are not treated as trusted claims. The configured verifier can satisfy the stated independent planning-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct PRD, manifest, evaluation-source and executing-module digest domains. Earlier preparation placeholders in originalSpecification are distinguished from the frozen preview inputs. This approval uses only the supplied specification and evidence, not candidate results, and neither creates human attestations nor authorizes execution or dispatch. Digests and mechanical bindings are accepted as Service-supplied facts; I did not recompute them or execute code.
